nodes.title: Upstream module and plugin parity
nodes.description: Account for every Tika 4.2 module: plugins-core, handlers, encoding-detectors, image-processing, ml, bundles, annotation processor, test-support, serialization, xmp, metadata-schema, integration tests, examples.

nodes.title: Security and hardening
nodes.description: XXE, bombs, traversal, SSRF, worker isolation, temp/secrets hygiene, regex DoS, supply chain.

nodes.title: Testing, parity evidence, performance
nodes.description: Differential harness, corpus, fuzzing, memory/abort, platform matrix, benchmarks, published parity report.

nodes.title: Packaging, docs, and 1.0 release
nodes.description: Monorepo build, publishes, docs, migration guide, CI, provenance/SBOM, release.

nodes.title: tika-plugins-core parity
nodes.description: Plugin discovery and component lifecycle equivalent. Acceptance: plugin loading tests.

nodes.title: tika-handlers module parity
nodes.description: All upstream handler types and composition. Acceptance: handler inventory audit.

nodes.title: tika-encoding-detectors parity
nodes.description: Encoding detector components and confidence behavior. Acceptance: fixture matrix.

nodes.title: tika-image-processing parity
nodes.description: Image preprocessing/rendering utilities needed by OCR. Acceptance: utility parity tests.

nodes.title: tika-ml parity assessment
nodes.description: Inventory upstream ML components; implement only what affects parser parity, otherwise document non-goal. Acceptance: decision recorded.

nodes.title: tika-bundles equivalent
nodes.description: Parser bundle/meta-packages with tree-shaking. Acceptance: bundle import tests.

nodes.title: Annotation-processor equivalent codegen
nodes.description: Build-time generation for metadata/component metadata. Acceptance: generated outputs reproducible.

nodes.title: tika-test-support equivalent
nodes.description: Shared fixtures, assertions, parser conformance helpers. Acceptance: used by all parser packages.

nodes.title: tika-serialization parity
nodes.description: JSON/XML metadata serializers and writer limits. Acceptance: golden output.

nodes.title: tika-xmp parity
nodes.description: XMP parse/write across PDF/images/Office. Acceptance: round-trip fixtures.

nodes.title: tika-metadata-schema parity
nodes.description: Full property schema, namespaces, types, case rules. Acceptance: key coverage audit.

nodes.title: tika-integration-tests equivalent
nodes.description: Cross-package integration suite mirroring upstream scenarios. Acceptance: CI green.

nodes.title: tika-example equivalent
nodes.description: Runnable examples for each public API surface. Acceptance: examples build in CI.

nodes.title: Legacy module disposition (java7, batch, fuzzing)
nodes.description: Record why tika-java7/tika-batch/tika-fuzzing are not ported; map functionality to pipes/fuzz suite. Acceptance: parity report notes.

nodes.title: XXE/DTD/entity-expansion protection
nodes.description: No DTD, no external entities, expansion cap zero, XInclude off. Acceptance: adversarial suite.

nodes.title: Decompression bomb protections
nodes.description: Ratio/per-entry/total/entry-count caps across zip, compressors, archives. Acceptance: bomb corpus.

nodes.title: Archive path traversal and symlink safety
nodes.description: Reject absolute/.. entries, never follow links/devices, confined unpack. Acceptance: traversal corpus.

nodes.title: Fetcher SSRF protections
nodes.description: Scheme/host allowlists, loopback/link-local/metadata IP denial, redirect caps, DNS rebinding check. Acceptance: SSRF corpus.

nodes.title: Worker isolation and resource caps
nodes.description: Unsafe parsers run isolated with memory/time limits and no credentials. Acceptance: crash containment tests.

nodes.title: Temp file permissions, cleanup, no world-readable
nodes.description: 0600, unpredictable names, cleanup on abort/error/exit. Acceptance: leak tests.

nodes.title: Secret handling and redaction
nodes.description: Passwords/credentials never logged or serialized; provider callbacks. Acceptance: log scan.

nodes.title: Regex DoS protections for user patterns
nodes.description: Pattern length caps and optional RE2-compatible engine. Acceptance: ReDoS tests.

nodes.title: Supply chain: SBOM, license gate, no install scripts
nodes.description: Lockfile, provenance, SBOM, dependency audit, pinned optional peers. Acceptance: CI gate.

nodes.title: Differential harness against Tika 4.2 and 3.3
nodes.description: Container oracle, golden capture, comparator with normalization and thresholds, triage reports. Acceptance: runs in CI without Docker via goldens.

nodes.title: Corpus: fixtures, public samples, fuzz inputs, adversarial set
nodes.description: Content-addressed manifest, licensing recorded, checksums, no blobs in git. Acceptance: corpus build reproducible.

nodes.title: Golden output storage and regeneration policy
nodes.description: Versioned oracle headers, reviewed regeneration, diffs for every failure. Acceptance: policy enforced.

nodes.title: Fuzzing: OSS-Fuzz replay and mutation
nodes.description: No crashes, unbounded allocations, unhandled rejections; cleanup verified. Acceptance: nightly fuzz job.

nodes.title: Streaming memory ceiling tests
nodes.description: 100x buffer-size documents bounded; no collect in parser paths. Acceptance: CI memory gate.

nodes.title: Abort, cancellation, and resource leak tests
nodes.description: Randomized cancellation points; temp files/workers cleaned. Acceptance: leak detector green.

nodes.title: Node 20/22/24, Bun, Deno matrix
nodes.description: Runtime compatibility suite. Acceptance: CI matrix green.

nodes.title: Browser subset suite (Chromium, WebKit)
nodes.description: Detection + text/HTML/XML/ZIP via Playwright; declared unsupported features error clearly. Acceptance: green.

nodes.title: Bundle size and tree-shaking gates
nodes.description: Per-package budgets; importing one parser must not pull others; no side effects. Acceptance: CI size report.

nodes.title: Type tests and API Extractor report
nodes.description: tsd/expect-type coverage; public API diff gate. Acceptance: CI green.

nodes.title: Benchmark suite and trend storage
nodes.description: Detection ops/s, format throughput, memory, cold start, worker overhead. Acceptance: nightly results.

nodes.title: Performance regression gates
nodes.description: Fail on >10% throughput or >15% memory regression. Acceptance: CI gate.

nodes.title: Published per-format parity report
nodes.description: Every parser and feature: parity status, thresholds, documented differences and gaps. Acceptance: generated from harness, no hand claims.

nodes.title: Monorepo build: workspaces, TS project refs, ESM+CJS
nodes.description: Deterministic builds, declarations, source maps, export maps. Acceptance: clean build from clone.

nodes.title: Package publishing and optional peer strategy
nodes.description: Versioning, peer deps, install hints, no lifecycle scripts. Acceptance: pack/install tests.

nodes.title: Documentation: API reference, guides, security model
nodes.description: Generated API docs, per-parser docs, limits, security guidance. Acceptance: docs build.

nodes.title: Migration guide from Java Tika and 3.x semantics
nodes.description: Concept mapping, defaults, behavioral differences, config translation. Acceptance: reviewed.

nodes.title: Feature parity matrix and gap register
nodes.description: Module/parser/feature matrix with status and evidence links. Acceptance: 100% module accounting.

nodes.title: CI: build, test, parity, security, benchmarks
nodes.description: Matrix, caching, artifact retention, nightly jobs. Acceptance: green pipeline.

nodes.title: 1.0 release checklist
nodes.description: API freeze, parity report, security review, SBOM, provenance, changelog. Acceptance: signed release.

nodes.title: Provenance and SBOM publication
nodes.description: SLSA-style provenance and SBOM per package. Acceptance: artifacts published.
